items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The band continued, but Sam Johnson . . . Sam Donald kept . . .

ctx.x: There’s a story in it called, “A Nice Little Postwar Business.” That’s the book up there. It deals with that. Coming back, we were all pretty beat up. The band was washed up. When we came back to the States, I was surveyed, dropped out. Maxie Kaminsky was
dropped out. Davey Tough was dropped out. A lot of people. The band continued, but Sam Johnson . . . Sam Donald kept . . .
